training_method: fresh random initialization; no pretrained weights and no hosted AI API
architecture: decoder-only Transformer with RoPE, RMSNorm, SwiGLU and causal scaled dot-product attention
limitations: This is an experimental base language model, not a ChatGPT-level general assistant.
The training corpus remains Shakespeare-heavy plus the short Dying Ember source document.
The Dying Ember document is not the missing FAI conversation archive.
The checkpoint is not automatically loaded by the live website chat runtime.
